description: 11e FIRE OVERWATCH (15.08) used by the AI at the end of the HUMAN's Movement phase: the result toast. Fixture ork11e_orks_reactive (P1 Custodes active, round 2, 6 CP each). Set-up (scripted): the Orks (P2) are handed to the AI, the human lets the computer allocate wounds (auto-allocate ON, so the snap shot resolves at once), and Custodian Guard Gamma is made a soft target (T3, no save) so the AI's expected-damage rule fires. The human ends the Movement phase with the phase button (real click): the AI answers its movement_phase_end window synchronously INSIDE that END_MOVEMENT — FIRE OVERWATCH, 1 CP — the snap shot resolves, and the 'FIRE OVERWATCH: … snap-shot …' result toast is shown to the human. Before this fix the toast was only raised by the window-dialog / movement-action / network paths, never by the phase button's END_MOVEMENT, so the human saw nothing.

steps.comment: set-up: P2 = AI, auto-allocate ON, soft target
the human is shown the AI's snap-shot result
the AI paid 1 CP for FIRE OVERWATCH
the AI's use is in its action log / turn summary
